name: social-media-marketing-automation
description: White-label multi-tenant social media marketing automation platform

scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -n infra,core,api,worker,web -c blue,yellow,green,magenta,cyan "npm:dev:infra" "npm:dev:core" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:admin: npm run build:core && concurrently -n admin-api,admin-web -c green,cyan "npm:dev:admin:api" "npm:dev:admin:web"
scripts.create-superadmin: npm run build:core && npm -w @smma/admin run create-superadmin --
scripts.migrate: npm run build:core && npm -w @smma/server run migrate
scripts.seed: npm run build:core && npm -w @smma/server run seed
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm -w @smma/server run build && npm -w @smma/web run build && npm -w @smma/admin run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm -w @smma/server run typecheck && npm -w @smma/web run typecheck && npm -w @smma/admin run typecheck
scripts.test: npm -w @smma/server run test && npm -w @smma/admin run test
